jem.settlements.view.treasury_help: Treasury transfers remain in the Economy ledger; chest stock is never a balance and players are never taxed for standing here.
jem.settlements.view.buildings_help: Facilities are recorded only after real block/POI interaction. Visual influence never grants build or chest permissions.
jem.settlements.view.projects_help: City and citadel progress observes genuine native machines, guards and settled trade; aesthetic scores and End progression are not requirements.
jem.settlements.view.projects_phase2: Town tiers use verified homes, native jobs, real linked storage and happiness. No authored Phase-2 blueprint is installed, so physical construction stays disabled instead of placing placeholder houses over player builds.
jem.settlements.view.happiness_help: Improve real homes near linked beds: combine comfort, lit warmth, greenery, culture, work identity and social furniture. One repeated block type caps quickly. Feed varied edible items; unsafe food always hurts. Evidence from unloaded chunks is marked stale until verified.
jem.settlements.view.no_simulation: No completed inactive interval yet. Another nearby player keeps the settlement fully active.
jem.settlements.view.guide: Food: drop one edible item within 3 blocks of a hungry registered villager, or enable a linked chest with /jem town feedstorage on. Homes: link real beds/worksites, then use 3+ different amenity categories. Defense: fund the Treasury before each 168,000-tick payroll. Return: catch-up models at most six days and never invents Worker output.
jem.settlements.mount.summary: Personal mounts: %s lifetime (%s living), %s/%s eligible types.
jem.settlements.view.market_limits: NPC payout left: you %s / world %s Copper
jem.settlements.food.detail: Base value; repetition and current mood can reduce the actual gain.
jem.settlements.territory.changed: Settlement territory radius is now %s blocks. This is guidance, not a land claim.
jem.settlements.territory.rejected: Territory radius %s conflicts with another town or is not allowed.
jem.settlements.guidebook.received: Settlement guidebook added to your inventory.
